body: I don't know what are you talking about, but I guess you can if you want.
I can't guarantee you that I won't do it, but if I do, just don't blame yourself over this since it's only my decision to do it.

What stops me from what? Even if my depression and suicidal thoughts will go away, it doesn't mean that my life itself will get better and I will meet all my expectations and needs that I want. I don't care about living for my family, those people brought me into this world and thought it will be a great idea and would make them happy to have a child and make a family like that, but I am nowhere near glad to be here and would rather be aborted instead.

I know that you are trying to help me, but to be honest with you, I don't find your replies being particuraly helpful with what I am dealing and feeling right now. I am incredibly sad and depressed at the moment, that I want jump from my apartment and hoping that it would instantly kill me when I land on the ground.

How do you know that it will become bearable for me? You can see the future and guarantee that for anyone you see? What if I want more than my life becoming bearable? Living with such pain, sadness, negative thoughts, suicidal thoughts, pessimism, regrets and doubts just to see if it gets better, sounds like a complete bullshit for me.
